title: Book Three · Chapter 181: The Last Class Afternoon
story:
In early winter, Ronan's final local school term comes to an end.

On the last class afternoon, the teacher gives everyone time for a favourite piece from their work.

Kai brings out the old play sheet. There are still pencil marks beside the traveller's lines.

“This one?” he asks Ronan.

Ronan smiles and takes the second page.

“Your turn to be old.”

Kai puts two chairs at the front. Ronan carries his bag between them and asks the way to the market.

“A basket?” Kai says.

“The market.”

“I haven't got a basket.”

The class laughs. Ronan looks at the board, then back at the page.

He knows the next line. He waits until Kai has finished before he gives it.

The traveller reaches the wrong house once more. Kai sends him back toward the chairs with a large wave.

When they sit down, Anna is smiling beside Ronan's desk.

“Still a difficult journey,” she says.

“Very little bus fare,” he answers.

She laughs and gives him his pencil. Other students read, explain pictures, or show a page they remember well.

The teacher listens from the side. Near the end, she closes her book and looks around the room.

“Your term's work is complete.” The room is quiet for a moment.

There are questions about collecting the last papers. She answers each one, then tells Ronan to come on Monday for his final teacher's note.

It is the update the coastal centre requested. The earlier application is already there.

After class, Ronan puts the play sheet with his own work. Kai checks the space under his chair for his ball.

“A game?”

“A short one.”

They go to the field with two other boys. Anna and Lin have their own books to collect, so they leave by the library path.

The game is untidy and full of laughter. One boy kicks too high, and Kai sends the ball back before it reaches the far path.

Ronan makes a good pass, then misses the next. He runs after the ball and turns back with it beneath one arm.

For a moment, he sees the classroom windows above the field. Their desk is empty now.

Kai calls his name. Ronan puts the ball down and sends it toward him.

They play until the cold reaches their hands. Then they collect the bags and walk out together, arguing cheerfully about the last goal.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

favourite piece＝最喜欢的一段作品；collect＝领取、收好；update＝最新补充说明；cheerfully＝轻松愉快地。

## 理解问题

1. 最后课堂上他们怎样换角色重读旧剧？这是新的资格选拔或获奖吗？
2. 本地这一学段完成后，Ronan还需在周一领取什么、供哪件申请使用？

## 读句子

**Your term's work is complete.**

拆开看：Your term's work / is / complete.

你们这个学段的学习任务／已经／完成。
